name: rapp-workspace-starter
purpose: Drop-in pack for a chief-of-staff style private workspace, conformant to rapp-workspace/1.1: CLAUDE.md/HOME.md/PERSONA.md/where-everything-lives.md, standard sections (strategy/portfolio/projects/reference/people/meetings/connect/role), and the rapp-projects frame authority. WorkspaceFactory pulls + verify_egg()s the canonical template before planting, then re-mints a fresh rappid per instance. Newer shape than the neighborhood-starter/microsoft-365-team stacks: this plants a private organizing VAULT for one owner and one world, not an agent-team neighborhood. public mode is refused by design — a planted workspace holds real PII; only this stack's own template .egg is meant to be public. Ships with WorkspaceNeuron: a generic, PII-free Knowledge Base of the spec's setup/operating rules injected into the brainstem prompt, so a planted workspace's own .md files stay owner-specific instead of re-explaining the protocol.

factory_agent.py.purpose: Drop into local brainstem agents/. Run WorkspaceFactory to plant a workspace.

workspace_neuron_agent.py.purpose: Optional, tool-form. Drop into local brainstem agents/@rapp/ alongside the factory. Injects a compact [Knowledge Base] of rapp-workspace/1.1 + rapp/1 setup and operating rules (anatomy, identity/mint-once, privacy posture, the egg contract, the frame authority) — generic and PII-free, never owner-specific. No install step; the brainstem's agent loader picks it up as a callable tool. Keeps that knowledge out of every planted workspace's CLAUDE.md/README.md prose. Also published standalone at agents/@rapp/workspace_neuron_agent.py.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_anatomy.neu.purpose: Optional, storage-form twin of the same knowledge (same content, generated from the same source, never drifts). For a CommunityRAPP-style backend: install with install_neurons.py so it lands in the RAPP Web UI's system prompt automatically, no tool call needed. schema/id/name/version/category/description/scope/author/memories — same shape as install_neurons.py's own @platform/*.neuron.json packs.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_identity.ne.purpose: Storage-form neuron: mint-once identity rules. See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_privacy.neu.purpose: Storage-form neuron: privacy & sovereignty rules (public mode refusal). See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp1_egg_contract.neuron..purpose: Storage-form neuron: the rapp/1 §9 egg contract. See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_projects_frame_author.purpose: Storage-form neuron: the rapp-projects frame authority (leases, fork recovery). See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

rapp-workspace-starter.egg.purpose: Template content (rapp/1 §9 organism egg, 24 files, PII-free, verify_egg-clean). The factory pulls + verifies + customizes this at plant time.
